content:
Smaller and quieter alternative to my 3qt Instant Pot
I have had my Instant Pot 3qt Duo for over eight years and recently steam has been coming out of the sides and water from the valve. I have trouble getting it to raise to pressure bc I use small quanities and cook time and pretty much everything is over/undercooking as a result. I keep it above the fridge since counter space is very limited.

I like being able to plug it in and leave the house and have perfect rice. I mainly use it weekly for about half a cup of raw grains, steaming one pound of chicken breasts, or lightly pre steaming two to three potatoes. I prefer not to turn on the stove but the Instant Pot feels bulky for such limited use.

Is there a smaller and reliable, safe option you would recommend for cooking for one that's QUIET, nontoxic, and "plug and play?" 

Thank you so much! This board always comes through.
